topic: the gate can report an authenticity FAIL when the candidate measured nothing at all

observation.gate_result: authenticity fail: "the candidate timed run launched no TileLang-generated kernel"
observation.context: the same window was classified as fully contended (0 quiet of 15) and the candidate produced no timing at all
observation.compile: .aibin artifacts were produced (2), so the archived source does compile to a device kernel

independent_check.method: loaded the archived v5 candidate directly and compared against CPU float64
independent_check.conclusion: the candidate is not delegating and does compute; the authenticity FAIL is a false positive produced when the device refused to launch under contention

why_it_matters: as written, a contended window turns into an authenticity accusation. That both misstates the candidate and can mask the real cause (a failed launch). It should be inconclusive, not a fail.
proposed_narrow_fix: when the candidate produced no measurement and no kernel of any kind was observed (no vendor operator either), report authenticity as inconclusive so the run RETESTs; keep the FAIL path for the case where a kernel was really launched and is not the candidate own, and for the vendor-operator case. This must be implemented with tests against the existing negative controls before use.
status: no performance claim; decode EXCEED (v4) and prefill 0.757 both stand
